scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm test:engineering && pnpm test:api
scripts.test:api: cd services/api && if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --extra dev pytest -q; else python3 -m pytest -q; fi
scripts.test:engineering: cd packages/engineering && if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --extra dev pytest -q; else python3 -m pytest -q; fi
